title: What the Capybara offers

is_this_you.pressure: When it gets loud, you sink until only your eyes and ears show. Still listening. Just not answering.
is_this_you.love: You love by feeding. The second cup arrives before anyone thinks to ask for it.
is_this_you.cost: People hand you their worst week the way they hand you a coat, and you take it without checking the pockets.

opener.text: Your animal's scientific name, Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris, reads as water hog, then water and enjoyment [wiki-capybara]. You were born under Cancer, the first water sign, in the year of the Pig, whose element is Water as well [astro-podcast] [wiki-pig]. So the water runs through you twice, and the name adds that it is meant to be enjoyed. Think of a capybara in a Japanese hot bath in midwinter, eyes half closed, in no hurry at all [spoon-tamago]. That is how you look when life is going right.

howto: Three parts. Take them slowly, in any order.

tabs.label: Your calm
tabs.intro: Water that holds, Water that shares.

rows.text: Cancer is cardinal Water, ruled by the Moon, and the old books give it the chest and the stomach, the body's places for feeding and holding [astro-podcast]. The Pig is yin Water, read as generous, compassionate and calm under pressure [wiki-pig] [chinahighlights-pig]. In you the two make a slow, warm current. You start things, and then you stay with them long enough to make them comfortable.

A capybara's eyes, ears and nostrils sit high on its head, so it can lie almost under and still keep track of the bank [wiki-capybara]. When danger comes, the group heads for the water and waits there [wlt] [pbs]. You keep the same habit. Under strain you go under with your senses up, and you surface when the noise has passed.

tabs.label: Your table
tabs.intro: Feed people. Let someone pay you for it.

rows.text: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer, and the pig is an old symbol of wealth [astro-podcast] [pearlriver-pig]. Your kind of plenty gets shared at a long table. Keep one pot of money nobody else can ask for, because the Pig is said to trust so readily it can be fooled [wiki-pig] [chinahighlights-pig].
Hosting, nursing and early-years teaching all reward the warmth you would give away anyway. Take the job where that warmth has a title and a wage.

tabs.label: Who sits beside you
tabs.intro: Three to share the warm water with, and one to watch from the bank.
tabs.love_lead: In love you are slow to anger and slower to forget. Birds land on capybaras to pick at ticks, and turtles climb aboard [schunck2025] [inat-wisnik]. You let people settle on you in much the same way. The old Chinese pairings name three who give the warmth back.

easy.why: The Sea Otter (Cancer, Rabbit year) shares your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and your Cancer sun as well [brief].
The Moon Bear (Cancer, Tiger year) is your secret friend, since the Tiger is the Pig's hidden ally [brief] [wiki-pig].
The Koala (Taurus, Rabbit year) is trine kin, and its Taurus Earth gives your Water a bank to rest against [brief].

hard.why: The hard one is the Tuatara: the Snake clashes with the Pig, and Capricorn sits opposite Cancer [brief] [wiki-pig].

story.text: In 1982 a keeper at Izu Shaboten Zoo saw the capybaras gathered in a warm puddle and filled a pool with hot water for them [spoon-tamago]. The winter bath became a national ritual, with yuzu and rose baths in rotation [spoon-tamago] [wiki-capybara].

closing: The bath is already warm. Come in, and keep a place free beside you.
